title: Solo dev, real-time strategy game made with AI tools
author: hexagongames314
selftext:
Hi! I'm a solo developer working on Merkalis: Conquest, a real-time strategy game about conquering territory, built in Unity 6. I don't have a team or a 3D artist, so AI tools covered a lot of the gaps.



\*\*What AI did\*\*

\- 3D models (units, faction knights, creatures) — generated in Meshy AI, then cleaned up and rigged by hand in Blender

\- \[other tools: e.g. code assistance, icons, UI art, etc.\]



\*\*What I did myself\*\*

All the game design: the rules, balance, combat system, factions and the overall concept. The core idea is that troops are the only resource — your land feeds your armies, while expanding, fighting and building all cost soldiers.



\*\*What I learned\*\*

AI speeds up asset production a lot, but the results still need manual work to fit together in one consistent style. And players notice — "looks AI" was one of the first comments I got elsewhere, so visual consistency is something I'm still working on.



Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268040/Merkalis\_Conquest/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5268040/Merkalis_Conquest/)



Happy to answer questions about the workflow!
